prompt: Under a vibrant blue sky, a young girl with pink hair sits on a striped towel in the center, building a sandcastle with a small plastic shovel. To her left, a boy with spiky brown hair pours water from a blue bucket into a moat around the castle, smiling broadly. A golden retriever dog lies on the right, chewing on a red frisbee while looking at the children. In the foreground, a pair of sunglasses rests on the sand next to a half-eaten ice cream cone melting slightly. A colorful beach ball rolls near the bottom edge, partially buried in the grains. Behind the group, a large umbrella with yellow and green stripes provides shade, its pole planted firmly in the sand. Two seagulls fly in the upper right corner, wings spread wide against the clouds. The ocean waves crash gently in the background, rendered with dynamic white foam and turquoise hues. Sunlight flares brightly from the top left, creating lens effects and warm highlights on the characters' skin. The scene exudes summer joy with exaggerated expressions and vibrant colors typical of the genre. This is an anime illustration.
